name: Candy Monsta

features.name: Sticky wilds in free spins
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 lock until the bonus ends.

features.name: Unlimited retriggers
features.description: Three or more scatters during free spins add more spins.

review:
A cute candy monster on a bright 5x3, 20-line grid full of sweets, jellies and letter symbols. A colourful candy is the wild.

Three or more Candy Castle scatters pay and give 10 free spins, with unlimited retriggers. In the bonus, wilds only land on reels 2, 3 and 4 – but every one sticks until the end, which is how the bigger wins build. Medium-high volatility, 2,077x max, free spins about once every 157 spins. The 94.03% RTP is one of the lowest here, so treat it as a fun demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
